_comment_schema: The version of a tool-call record's shape. A record of another version is counted and named by the reader, never read as a call — its fields may mean something else.
schemaVersion_note: The writer stamps this on every record; the reader compares it with this number.
_comment_retention: How long a record is kept. The writers delete what is older; the reader uses this as the window it reports over, and says so — 'all records' would mean 'all the records that still exist', which is not the same thing.
_comment_outcomes: The closed set of outcomes a call can have. The writer owns the spelling; the reader is strict about it, and an outcome it does not know is counted as unknown — not as an error, which would be a confident statement about a vocabulary it has not read.
_comment_sources: Who made the call. Two instrumentation points, one event schema.
